") and its joint venture partner and operator Riverside Resources Inc. ("Riverside") are pleased to announce the commencement of Phase 2B reverse circulation ("RC") drilling at the Luis Hill target at the La Union Project, Sonora, Mexico (Figure 1).
Phase 2B Program Overview
Luis Hill
: drilling will follow up on the
Phase 1 intercept of 42 metres grading 0.3 g/t gold* in
sediment-hosted mineralization (news release, January 12, 2026), probing deeper than previous holes to test the newly identified
+1 km
induced polarization ("IP") geophysical target and the extent of the shale beds encountered during core drilling (see Figures 2 and 3). The zone remains
open along strike and at depth.
Union Mine
: drilling will test the continuity of the feeder structure and three potentially mineralized stacked mantos near the historic workings, where chip channel sampling returned
30 m grading 20.2 g/t Au, 226 g/t Ag and 2.7% Zn
(see Figures 2 and 4).
Approximately 600 m of RC drilling is planned in two holes; the first, a near-vertical hole to a planned depth of approximately 350 m at Luis Hill, is underway.

Saf Dhillon, President and CEO of Questcorp, stated, "With the RC rig now turning at Luis Hill, Phase 2B has moved from preparation to drilling. This hole is designed to go deeper than our previous drilling and test the newly identified +1 km IP chargeability anomaly beneath our Phase 1 gold intercept, before we step out at the Union Mine to test the feeder structure and the stacked mantos projected from the historic workings. Because La Union's carbonate replacement deposit ("CRD") targets sit relatively close to surface, we believe RC drilling offers an efficient, cost-effective means of advancing our geological model, and we look forward to sharing results as they become available."

"We are pleased to continue Phase 2 drilling using RC drilling, a method we believe offers faster progress and larger sample volumes," said John-Mark Staude, President and CEO of Riverside. "We are excited to test geophysical features that correlate with the mapped geology and historic mining. Completion of the Phase 2 program will position the joint venture for the next phase of drilling, and we look forward to further exploration work at the La Union Project."
* Note: Drill intersection are down hole widths; true width is unknown at this time.

Luis Hill Target

The Phase 2B hole at Luis Hill is a near-vertical hole planned to approximately 350 m depth, designed to test the IP chargeability anomaly (Figure 3). Phase 2A hole UND26-018 was drilled above the anomaly but did not reach target depth. The Phase 2B hole is expected to test the mineralized horizon and nearby intrusions, where contacts with favourable host rocks may provide settings for mineralization.
Figure 3
: Cross-section of the Luis Hill target showing the IP chargeability anomaly and the Phase 2B drill hole. Section looking NNW; section line shown in Figure 2.
To view an enhanced version of this graphic, please visit:
Union Mine Target

The Union Mine structure is hosted in the Clemente Formation, a major CRD host unit. The planned Phase 2B hole will test the continuity of the Union Mine feeder structure, where continuous chip channel sampling returned 30 metres grading 20.2 g/t Au, 226 g/t Ag and 2.7% Zn (news release, January 22, 2026). Phase 2A hole UND26-013 intersected the continuation of the historic Sproul manto near the former underground workings. The Union Mine structure appears to have a geophysical expression in the magnetic tilt product (Figure 4A). The hole will also test for three potentially mineralized stacked mantos projected southward from the main historic mineralized zone of the Union Mine (Figure 4B).

About Questcorp Mining Inc.

Questcorp is engaged in the business of the acquisition and exploration of mineral properties in North America, with the objective of locating and developing economic precious and base metal properties of merit. The Company holds an undivided 100-per-cent interest in and to mineral claims totalling 1,168.09 hectares comprising the North Island Copper property, on Vancouver Island, B.C., subject to a royalty obligation. The Company also holds an option to acquire an undivided 100-per-cent interest in and to mineral claims totalling 2,520.2 hectares comprising the La Union Project located in Sonora, Mexico, subject to a royalty obligation.
